    Demo assumptions

    • Fees: flat 0.05% taker fee on notional at open and close. Maker fee 0%.
    • Margin: initial margin = notional / leverage. Cross mode, no partial margin.
    • Liquidation: simplified — entry × (1 ∓ (1/leverage − 0.5% maintenance)). Real venues use tiered maintenance margins.
    • Execution: market orders fill at the current simulated mark price with zero slippage. Limit and stop orders trigger when the mark crosses the trigger price.
    • Prices: deterministic seeded random walk, refreshed every 1.5 s. Not related to real markets.
    • Order book: a virtual book derived from the same simulation. It does not represent real liquidity or depth.
    • Funding: synthetic 1h rate applied to open positions every simulated hour in the demo scenario.

    These rules do not reproduce dYdX, Gains Network or any production execution model.
